_comment: Settings for the inbox pipeline (tools/ci.sh inbox). Set once, then dropping a model in inbox/ and running one command is the whole job. docs/architecture/inbox.md explains every field.

defaults._comment: Applied to every asset. author/source/license end up in pack.json and CREDITS.md; the pipeline refuses to guess them, because this repo publishes to the web on every merge.

bake._comment_forward: Which glTF axis the model's nose points down before the baker turns it. -z is the Blender/Meshy default and lands on grid `down`, the direction that shows a face. If the sheet comes out facing the wrong way, this is the one setting to change.
bake._comment_scale: One grid cell is this many metres of world. A 1.8m person comes out a little over a cell tall. Use fit_height instead to pin a sprite to an exact pixel height.
bake._comment_height: Squashes the model's up axis before the camera sees it. 1.0 is geometrically correct dimetric. The shipped placeholder tiles are flatter than that -- a cell-high wall is 0.82 cells at true scale -- so drop toward 0.8 if new art has to sit beside them rather than replace them.

assets._comment: Per-asset overrides, keyed by the file's name without its extension. Anything here beats defaults; a sidecar inbox/<name>.json beats both.
